plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 6th house: they bring structure to your routines, work, and health; discipline and reliability, or heaviness and obligation. Failure mode: the daily bond feels like duty. Build good systems together; don't let it become a job.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
